card.name: The zero in 200x years
card.fires_on: The digit 0 in the third place of a year written as 20 plus a digit, right before the last digit. It appears in dates such as "October 25, 2006" in news and web pages.

modes.label: Zero inside a 200x year
modes.description: The 0 after "20" in a full date, with the final year digit still to come.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are unrelated to each other, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks the zero in a year like 2006 when a news item or page gives a date.
